Nexa Halving Countdown: 2 Days 

The first and most important Nexa halving is approaching in less than 48 hours. The next upcoming halving will follow in approximately 4 years, around 2030. 

Nexa's total supply is designed to gradually reduce through halving cycles for more than 100 years. The final goal is to move to, and sustain mining rewards from transaction fees alone. 

It is the same model as Bitcoin's. However, in Nexa's case it is much more achievable due to its high transaction throughput, programmability, and size.

Decentralized applications, exchanges and other on-chain applications such as games, prediction markets, etc. can drastically contribute to an autonomous and sustainable ecosystem in a proof-of-work model.

Track the halving countdown
https://halving.nexa.org

Guide: How to Mine Nexa

Most blockchains are open and decentralized, and anyone can participate in mining. In a Proof-of-Work blockchain, the network is secured by solving mathematical problems and finding blocks.

In return, miners who find a block receive coins that represent the energy spent mining. In other words, you are getting rewarded by the protocol itself for securing it.

Mining cryptocurrency requires an internet connection, hardware, and dedicated software (or ASICs).

This guide walks through mining Nexa on Linux and Windows with a GPU.

The core developers from the Nexa team are integrating Tailstorm, a block-DAG-based design based on the Tailstorm research. The Tailstorm model represents a significant architectural evolution, moving away from a linear blockchain toward a directed acyclic graph (DAG) of subblocks, while preserving a conventional chain of “summary blocks.” Merging the summary-block model with the traditional chain allows Nexa to take advantage of both approaches while adopting more advanced mining and block-propagation mechanisms.

Find the link to the article below 👇

ज़्यादातर लोग इस मॉडल को पहले से जानते हैं, लेकिन हर कोई यह नहीं जानता कि नेक्सा जार बिटकॉइन के जार जैसा ही है।

कभी सोचा है कि 21 ट्रिलियन क्यों और 21 मिलियन क्यों नहीं? क्योंकि डेसिमल पॉइंट को छह जगह खिसका दिया गया था, जिससे एक सिक्के के हिस्से पूरी यूनिट में बदल गए।

सातोशी की कुल संख्या बिल्कुल बिटकॉइन के बराबर है: 2.1 क्वाड्रिलियन। नेक्सा बस आठ के बजाय दो डेसिमल रखता है, जो रोज़ाना इस्तेमाल के लिए कहीं ज़्यादा आसान है, ठीक वैसे ही जैसे हम फिएट को हैंडल करने के आदी हैं।

21 ट्रिलियन NEXA मैक्सिमम सप्लाई है, और आम सहमति से यह 2138 तक पूरी तरह से माइन नहीं होगा।

हर 1,050,000 ब्लॉक, लगभग चार साल में, माइनिंग रिवॉर्ड आधा कर दिया जाता है।

पहली Nexa हाफिंग 1 मई 2026 को हुई, जब ब्लॉक रिवॉर्ड 10,000,000 से घटकर 5,000,000 NEXA हो गया।

messages.translation:
Nexa Jar: Coin Tokenomics Explained

Most people already know this model, but not everyone knows that the Nexa jar is just like Bitcoin's jar.

Ever wondered why 21 trillion and not 21 million? Because the decimal point was shifted six places, turning fractions of a coin into whole units.

The total number of satoshis is exactly the same as Bitcoin's: 2.1 quadrillion. Nexa simply keeps two decimals instead of eight, which is far easier for everyday use, just like we're used to handling fiat.

21 trillion NEXA is the maximum supply, and by general consensus it won't be fully mined until 2138.

Every 1,050,000 blocks, roughly four years, the mining reward is halved.

The first Nexa halving happened on 1 May 2026, when the block reward dropped from 10,000,000 to 5,000,000 NEXA.

Stay with consensus: Update to Nexa Full-Node 2.2.0.0

Nexa is moving forward with protocol improvements, and we advise everyone to update their node client to the newest version.

This version includes rolling checkpoints. Once a block is 200 deep in the chain, the node marks it as settled. From that depth it becomes final, and any reorganization after that point is rejected.

For exchanges and services this means certainty: after 200 confirmations, a transaction cannot be reversed.

This is also the final release before the upcoming hard fork and Tailstorm protocol activation. It's essential to stay with consensus and update your client. 👇

भारत में NEXA को लेकर एक बहुत महत्वपूर्ण चीज़ जमीन पर बन रही है, जिसे सिर्फ chart और exchange volume देखकर समझना मुश्किल है।

आज कुछ छोटे शहरों, गाँवों और सामान्य परिवारों तक NEXA पहुँच चुका है। लोग OTC और P2P deals कर रहे हैं, और कई जगह local market में NEXA global market से 10%, 15% या कभी-कभी 20% तक premium पर खरीदा-बेचा जा रहा है।

मान लो किसी व्यक्ति को NEXA ₹100 के equivalent में मिलता है और local demand के कारण वही NEXA ₹115 में बिक जाता है।

उस ₹15 के फर्क को सिर्फ trading profit मत समझिए।

किसी सामान्य परिवार के लिए वही पैसा दाल, आटा, चावल, सब्जी, बच्चों की पढ़ाई, मोबाइल recharge या घर के दूसरे खर्च में काम आ सकता है।

यहीं से असली adoption शुरू होता है।

एक व्यक्ति NEXA खरीदता है।

दूसरे व्यक्ति को local market में NEXA चाहिए।

दोनों के बीच OTC deal होती है।

Price difference के कारण arbitrage बनता है।

किसी सामान्य व्यक्ति को छोटा margin मिलता है।

और वह margin वापस local economy में खर्च होता है।

यानी crypto सिर्फ exchange की screen पर नहीं घूम रहा, वह घर-गृहस्थी की economy में प्रवेश कर रहा है।

मेरे लिए यह बहुत fundamental use case है।

Smart contracts, applications, DeFi और बाकी technology अपनी जगह महत्वपूर्ण हैं, लेकिन अगर कोई decentralized coin किसी सामान्य व्यक्ति के लिए आर्थिक उपयोग पैदा कर देता है, तो उससे basic adoption और क्या होगा?

एक और महत्वपूर्ण बात:

Exchange का volume पूरी कहानी नहीं बताता।

India के अंदर wallet-to-wallet, OTC और local P2P में जो activity हो रही है, उसका बड़ा हिस्सा किसी एक exchange के volume में साफ दिखाई ही नहीं देगा।

कोई arbitrage कर रहा है।

कोई local buyer को supply कर रहा है।

कोई accumulate कर रहा है।

और कोई छोटा margin कमाकर अपने घर का खर्च चला रहा है।

मेरी इच्छा यह नहीं है कि सिर्फ India या Nepal आगे बढ़ें।

मैं चाहता हूँ कि दुनिया भर के लोग इस model को समझें और जहाँ कानून अनुमति देता है, वहाँ participate करें।

अगर India और Nepal में कोई useful P2P ecosystem बन रहा है, तो उसका knowledge पूरी global community के साथ share होना चाहिए।

Peer-to-peer money का सबसे सरल अर्थ यही है:

दो लोग सीधे value exchange कर सकें और उस network का वास्तविक जीवन में उपयोग हो।

जब NEXA किसी सामान्य परिवार तक पहुँचता है और उसके लिए economic opportunity पैदा करता है, तब वह सिर्फ एक coin नहीं रहता।

वह एक उपयोगी network बनना शुरू करता है।

असली adoption तब शुरू होता है जब सामान्य इंसान को किसी coin को use करने का वास्तविक कारण मिल जाए।

— Dhammadana
messages.translation:
Something very important is being built on the ground for NEXA in India, something that's hard to grasp by only looking at charts and exchange volume.

Today NEXA has reached some small towns, villages and ordinary families. People are doing OTC and P2P deals, and in many places NEXA is being bought and sold in the local market at a 10%, 15% or sometimes even 20% premium over the global market.

Suppose a person gets NEXA at the equivalent of ₹100 and, because of local demand, that same NEXA sells for ₹115.

Don't think of that ₹15 difference as merely trading profit.

For an ordinary family, that same money can go toward lentils, flour, rice, vegetables, the children's education, a mobile recharge, or other household expenses.

This is where real adoption begins.

One person buys NEXA.

Another person needs NEXA in the local market.

An OTC deal happens between the two.

Arbitrage is created because of the price difference.

An ordinary person gets a small margin.

And that margin is spent back into the local economy.

In other words, crypto isn't just moving around on an exchange screen, it's entering the household economy.

For me, this is a very fundamental use case.

Smart contracts, applications, DeFi and the rest of the technology are important in their own place, but if a decentralized coin creates economic utility for an ordinary person, what greater basic adoption could there be?

Another important point:

Exchange volume doesn't tell the whole story.

A large part of the wallet-to-wallet, OTC and local P2P activity happening inside India will simply not be visible in any single exchange's volume.

Someone is doing arbitrage.

Someone is supplying a local buyer.

Someone is accumulating.

And someone is earning a small margin and running their household with it.

My wish is not that only India or Nepal move forward.

I want people all over the world to understand this model and participate wherever the law permits.

If a useful P2P ecosystem is being built in India and Nepal, then that knowledge should be shared with the entire global community.

The simplest meaning of peer-to-peer money is this:

Two people can exchange value directly and that network gets used in real life.

When NEXA reaches an ordinary family and creates economic opportunity for them, it stops being just a coin.

It starts becoming a useful network.

Real adoption begins when an ordinary human being gets a real reason to use a coin.

— Dhammadana

messages.text:

Kuch families, especially chhote towns aur villages mein, NEXA ki OTC buying-selling aur arbitrage se earning kar rahi hain. Log ek market se buy karke doosre market mein sell karte hain, aur isi process se local NEXA market develop ho raha hai.

Mere liye real adoption ka matlab sirf price badhna nahi hai. Real adoption tab hai jab technology aur network aam logon ke kaam aaye, unke liye opportunities create kare aur local economy mein actual use ho.

India aur Nepal mein ab wahi process start hota dikh raha hai.

Aur yeh sirf India ya Nepal tak limited nahi rehna chahiye. Jahan bhi log NEXA ko responsibly use karke local markets aur opportunities build kar sakte hain, unhe participate karna chahiye.

NEXA sirf ek coin nahi, ek open network hai. Iski asli value tab banegi jab iska fayda ground level par logon tak pahuche.
messages.translation:
In India and Nepal, NEXA's real adoption is slowly reaching the ground level.

Some families, especially in small towns and villages, are earning from OTC buying-selling and arbitrage of NEXA. People buy in one market and sell in another, and through this very process a local NEXA market is developing.

For me, real adoption doesn't just mean the price going up. Real adoption is when the technology and the network are useful to ordinary people, create opportunities for them, and get actual use in the local economy.

That same process now seems to be starting in India and Nepal.

And this shouldn't stay limited to just India or Nepal. Wherever people can use NEXA responsibly and build local markets and opportunities, they should participate.

NEXA isn't just a coin, it's an open network. Its real value will be created when its benefit reaches people at the ground level.

हार्डवेयर एक्सेलरेशन: सर्किट के ज़रिए स्केलिंग

इस सीरीज़ के दूसरे लेख में, Nexa का वैलिडेशन इंजन छह कंपोनेंट्स, एक टेप और एक हेड से बनाया गया था। इसने बिना किसी सॉफ़्टवेयर को चलाए, ऐलिस से बॉब को पेमेंट पूरा करके दिखाया।

क्योंकि टेप हमेशा आगे की दिशा में ही चलता था, इसलिए इंजन ने उन चार शर्तों में से पहली शर्त पूरी कर ली जो एक बेहतर बिटकॉइन के लिए ज़रूरी हैं: यह पाइपलाइन-योग्य (pipelineable) था।

यह लेख बाकी शर्तों को भी पूरा करता है। जैसा कि Nexa के चीफ़ साइंटिस्ट डॉ. पीटर रिज़ुन (@PeterRizun) ने सिडनी में दिखाया था, हम सतोशी के बिटकॉइन में सुधार कर सकते हैं और सिर्फ़ तीन आसान बदलावों से उन सभी शर्तों को पूरा कर सकते हैं। साथ ही, इंजन को दो और खूबियां—एक्सटेंसिबिलिटी (विस्तार की क्षमता) और कंप्रेसिबिलिटी (डेटा छोटा करने की क्षमता)—लगभग मुफ़्त में मिल जाती हैं।

Because the tape always moved only in the forward direction, the engine satisfied the first of the four conditions required for a better Bitcoin: it was pipelineable.

This article fulfills the remaining conditions as well. As Nexa's chief scientist Dr. Peter Rizun (@PeterRizun) showed in Sydney, we can improve on Satoshi's Bitcoin and meet all those conditions with just three simple changes. On top of that, the engine gets two more qualities—extensibility and compressibility—almost for free.

summary.headline: A six-month announcement-heavy window: Nexa's first halving, Tailstorm/hard-fork prep, hardware R&D, and grassroots India adoption talk.
summary.summary: This window spans late March to mid-September 2026 and is dominated by official announcements posted by Blacktea ▽, with only light chatter from members. The centerpiece is Nexa's first halving on 1 May 2026 (block reward cut from 10M to 5M NEXA), surrounded by countdowns, a NiftyArt 'Halving Fest' art contest and an X Spaces event. After that, the feed tracks protocol work — Tailstorm/DAG integration, preparations for Hard Fork #2, Full-Node 2.2.0.0 as the 'final checkpoint', NexaPoW 2.0 and Peter Rizun's hardware/Blitz article series — plus developer tooling (NexScript v1.1.0 and Playground, explorer, LibNexaKotlin, Wally Wallet) and the 4-year anniversary Spaces with Andrew Stone. The main community voice is DhammaDana, who pushes a grassroots evangelism message and argues that real Indian adoption is happening off-exchange via OTC/P2P deals at 10–20% local premiums. Sour notes are few but real: warnings that Nexamine is not an official project, the Exbitron and BitMart exchange shutdown notices, a bot-raid/CAPTCHA incident on 1 September, and one spam link.

topics.title: First Nexa halving
topics.summary: Blacktea ▽ and DhammaDana ran a countdown to the 1 May 2026 halving, confirmed the block reward drop from 10,000,000 to 5,000,000 NEXA, and promoted the 'New Baseline' Spaces plus the Halving Fest 2026 artwork contest on NiftyArt.

topics.title: Tailstorm, hard fork and node releases
topics.summary: A long run of Blacktea ▽ posts on Hard Fork #2 preparation, Tailstorm block-DAG integration, monthly dev updates, NexaPoW 2.0 with a cellular-automaton ASIC-resistant redesign, and the call for everyone to upgrade to Full-Node 2.2.0.0 with rolling checkpoints before Tailstorm activation.

topics.title: Developer tooling and ecosystem
topics.summary: Announcements on NexScript v1.1.0 and its regtest default, NexScript Playground upgrades, Nexa Explorer features and self-hosting, LibNexaKotlin wallet stability, Wally Wallet P2P offers, the updated 2026-27 roadmap, NiftyArt stats and the 'Nexa Warriors' on-chain card game demo.

topics.title: Hardware acceleration / Blitz
topics.summary: Blacktea ▽ published a Peter Rizun article series on why Nexa builds hardware — an FPGA/silicon node that validates signatures — including 'A Node Made of Wires' and 'Scaling by Circuit', framed as removing the full-node bottleneck.

topics.title: 4-year anniversary and Spaces
topics.summary: The 21 June 2026 anniversary X Spaces with founder Andrew Stone, Andrea Suisani and David Thibodeau was announced, held, recapped, and followed by commemorative NFTs for attendees; June highlights also credited ambassador Kashish Gupta's 'Nexa Bharat Yatra: Bihar Chapter'.

topics.title: India grassroots adoption push
topics.summary: DhammaDana urged members to become 'the catalyst' by convincing friends to hold 1–10 billion NEXA, and later argued at length that real adoption in India and Nepal is happening through OTC/P2P deals at 10–20% local premiums that put money into household economies, invisible in exchange volume.

topics.title: Webinars and education
topics.summary: Blacktea ▽ promoted and recapped webinars with EvolvH3R: smart contracts with David Thibodeau, gaming with Steven van den Meiracker, and proof-of-work with Bitcoin Unlimited president Andrew Clifford; Rinku Ram shared a video of meeting Clifford in person.

topics.title: Exchange shutdowns and third-party warnings
topics.summary: K. I. reported invalid authenticator OTP on Nexamine and Blacktea ▽ warned it is not an official Nexa project; later Blacktea ▽ posted notices that Exbitron is closing permanently and that BitMart announced a shutdown.

topics.title: Bot raid, moderation and greetings
topics.summary: On 1 September Blacktea ▽ triggered antiraid mode and noted nobody was passing CAPTCHA; Asin pushed back, saying real invitees were being blocked and that India is unlikely to see bot attacks. Routine welcomes from Rose and greetings from Arun Dutta, Ravi Tembhare and others fill the rest, plus one off-topic spam link from Alex ▼.

summary.mood_description: The tone is consistently upbeat but largely one-directional: Blacktea ▽ broadcasts milestones and the room responds with little discussion. Genuine excitement peaks around the May halving and the June anniversary Spaces, and again with the hardware/NexaPoW 2.0 reveals. The only friction points are the Nexamine support complaint, the Exbitron and BitMart shutdown notices, and a brief disagreement over antiraid mode blocking legitimate new members. DhammaDana's grassroots posts inject the most authentic community energy in the window.

highlights.why: The core event of the window: confirmation that Nexa's first halving executed and block rewards dropped to 5,000,000 NEXA.
DhammaDana's long, concrete account of NEXA trading at 10-20% local premiums via OTC/P2P in small Indian towns — the most substantive community post here.
DhammaDana's 'become the catalyst' call to action urging every member to recruit holders of 1-10 billion NEXA; notable for its supply-squeeze framing.
Warning that BitMart is shutting down, following the Exbitron closure — the clearest negative development for Indian holders' liquidity.
Asin pushing back on the antiraid lockdown, arguing real invited users were being shut out — the only visible disagreement in the window.
Full-Node 2.2.0.0 announced as the final checkpoint before the Tailstorm hard fork, with an explicit upgrade and wallet-backup call to node operators.
